Application Data.NAME: Cozy Haven Inn

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Cozy Haven Inn is a charming bed and breakfast located in a quiet residential area, offering a cozy atmosphere and personalized service to our guests. With a total of 8 guest rooms, each uniquely decorated, we provide a comfortable stay for travelers exploring Springfield. Our operations are year-round, featuring complimentary breakfast services that adhere to strict food safety protocols. Our property is well-maintained, equipped with modern fire protection systems, and complies with local safety regulations. Our guest experience is enhanced by the scenic garden and outdoor seating areas, perfect for relaxation after a day of exploring the local attractions.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 04/15/2022, a guest accidentally spilled hot coffee on themselves in the dining area, resulting in minor burns and a medical claim. The total cost for medical expenses was $2,500. The claim is currently closed, and the guest reported satisfactory resolution. Additionally, on 09/10/2021, a small fire caused by an electrical issue in the kitchen led to property damage amounting to $2,500, which was fully repaired. This incident was reported to the insurance company, and the claim was settled positively, with no ongoing concerns.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing around the property, in addition to utilizing a professional security service during high-occupancy events to ensure guest safety and security.
